notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE V2.1
notes.notes:
[b]NOW ON WINDOWS AND OSX[/b]

osx users, as the app has been deeply rewritten, make a clean reinstall (uninstall first if you had a previous version, save your projects first by copy/paste )
any issue mail benoit@pix-arts.com

IMPORT YOUR OWN ASSETS

You have now possibility to import your own graphic ans sound assets and use them within the application

EXPORT PROJECT AS STANDARD HTML5 APPLICATION - PUBLISH EVERYWHERE

You can now export a build of your projects along their source files as standard HTML5 Applications that can be run in any browsers. You may the build ios/android applications with the free ADOBE PHONEGAP (TM) cloud service. You can also publish on all majors platforms (ios/android/mac oxs/ windows 10) as standolone applications using the open source CORDOVA framework. Built applications are all yours and you are free to publish them on any store with no restrictions. If you do, we would like to learn about it!

Runtime Virtual Machine has also been optimized for highest excution speed

Input function bug has been corrected
